# armands.blog

> Personal blog of [Armand Viktor Bozsik](https://armands.site) – computer science graduate (University of Szeged, 2020).
> Bilingual (English / Hungarian). Posts cover IT security, Linux, Windows, how-tos and projects.
> Static site, no tracking, no ads. Accessibility statement: [/en/accessibility/](https://armands.blog/en/accessibility/) and [/hu/accessibility/](https://armands.blog/hu/accessibility/).

## Content

- [English posts](https://armands.blog/en/posts/)
- [Hungarian posts](https://armands.blog/hu/posts/)
- [Topics / tags (EN)](https://armands.blog/en/tags/) and [topics / tags (HU)](https://armands.blog/hu/tags/)
- [About](https://armands.blog/en/about/)
- Search index (JSON): [/en/index.json](https://armands.blog/en/index.json) and [/hu/index.json](https://armands.blog/hu/index.json)

## Site conventions for agents

- Languages live under [/en/](https://armands.blog/en/) and [/hu/](https://armands.blog/hu/); each page declares its lang and links to its translation.
- The site is generated by Hugo from [gitlab.com/bozsikarmand/armands-blog](https://gitlab.com/bozsikarmand/armands-blog).
- Theme source: [gitlab.com/bozsikarmand/hugo-theme-armands-blog](https://gitlab.com/bozsikarmand/hugo-theme-armands-blog)
- Contact: hello@armands.site
